title: 2.9 Environment Protection
description: Proper disposal procedures for computer equipment and e-waste

questions.question: What are proper disposal procedures in a computer perspective?
options: Procedures for installing new software on old computers
Appropriate and environmentally responsible methods of getting rid of computer equipment and electronic waste
Methods for increasing the speed of a computer before selling it
Techniques for repairing damaged circuit boards at home
questions.correctAnswer: Appropriate and environmentally responsible methods of getting rid of computer equipment and electronic waste

questions.question: Why is proper disposal of computer equipment important?
options: To speed up the internet connection of new devices
To increase the resale price of every old device
To reduce the number of computer ports available
To minimize environmental impact, prevent pollution and promote sustainable practices
questions.correctAnswer: To minimize environmental impact, prevent pollution and promote sustainable practices

questions.question: Why should you engage with authorized e-waste recyclers?
options: They are equipped to handle and process electronic waste in an environmentally friendly manner
They remove all ports and cables from the device
They buy old equipment at the highest prices
They install new operating systems for free
questions.correctAnswer: They are equipped to handle and process electronic waste in an environmentally friendly manner

questions.question: What should be done with data before disposing of any computer equipment?
options: Rename all files with a single character
Copy the data to a visible folder on the desktop
Leave the data intact so it can be recovered by the next user
Securely erase all data using data wiping tools or software that comply with industry standards for data sanitization
questions.correctAnswer: Securely erase all data using data wiping tools or software that comply with industry standards for data sanitization

questions.question: What is a recommended option for computer equipment that is still functional and in good condition?
options: Donating or reselling it to extend its lifespan and reduce waste
Burying it in a landfill
Throwing it in the regular trash bin
Storing it outdoors behind the building
questions.correctAnswer: Donating or reselling it to extend its lifespan and reduce waste

questions.question: What are manufacturer take-back programs?
options: Programs that upgrade computers to a newer model for free
Programs through which manufacturers responsibly collect and recycle their products
Programs that share customer data with advertisers
Programs that sell computers back to the buyer at full price
questions.correctAnswer: Programs through which manufacturers responsibly collect and recycle their products

questions.question: What is the benefit of disassembling computer equipment and separating components for recycling?
options: It increases the total weight of the electronic waste
It allows for the proper recycling of individual components and materials like metals, plastics and circuit boards
It prevents any component from being reused
It removes the need to erase sensitive data
questions.correctAnswer: It allows for the proper recycling of individual components and materials like metals, plastics and circuit boards

questions.question: Which hazardous materials may be found in computers and other electronic devices?
options: Lead, mercury and flame-retardant chemicals
Oxygen, nitrogen and hydrogen
Sand, clay and gravel
Table salt, sugar and baking soda

questions.question: How should hazardous materials from computer equipment be handled?
options: By burning them in an open area
According to local regulations to prevent environmental contamination
By mixing them with ordinary household garbage
By pouring them into rivers and streams
questions.correctAnswer: According to local regulations to prevent environmental contamination

questions.question: Why should you familiarize yourself with local, regional and national regulations on electronic waste disposal?
options: To speed up the recycling process automatically
To follow the guidelines and ensure compliance with environmental laws
To obtain a discount on new computer purchases
To increase the voltage supplied to your computer
questions.correctAnswer: To follow the guidelines and ensure compliance with environmental laws

questions.question: True or False: Improper disposal of computer equipment can have detrimental effects on the environment and human health.
options: True
False

questions.question: True or False: Recycling programs specifically designed for electronic waste (e-waste) exist in many countries and organizations.
options: False
True
